name: Phenoxyethanol
description: Phenoxyethanol (CAS 122-99-6 ), also known as phenyl cellosolve and phenylmonoglycol ether, is a glycol ether used across personal care, pharmaceutical, and industrial markets. It functions primarily as a broad-spectrum preservative and solvent. This versatile chemical offers effective microbial control and formulation compatibility across a wide range of product types. In cosmetics and personal care, it is the preservative of choice in rinse-off and leave-on formulations. It is commonly found in lotions, shampoos, and wipes, where it controls bacterial and fungal contamination. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a solvent and antimicrobial agent in various topical preparations. These applications include creams and gels requiring low-irritation preservation systems. Industrial coatings and printing inks rely on it as a coalescing solvent and biocide to improve film formation and extend shelf life. In adhesives and sealants, it functions as a reactive diluent and preservation aid. This improves workability while protecting formulations during storage and ensuring long-term stability for industrial users. Phenoxyethanol is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities. Cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade material is available, with the latter meeting USP and Ph. Eur. specifications. Technical-grade product is also offered for industrial coating and ink applications.
